name: Tipsport
description: Unofficial Tipsport catalogue and shared live streaming using your own account.
overview: Native sports catalogue and one shared input

versions.changelog: Absorb high-bitrate HLS bursts in a bounded per-reader buffer instead of disconnecting at 128 pipe reads. Preserve one shared source, source quality and independent healthy viewers. Add numeric queue-overrun diagnostics and safe server warnings.

Login without copying cookies: provider window on the server or an HTTPS administrator form, including mobile devices. Optional encrypted credentials for bounded automatic recovery; failed password attempts pause further automatic submissions. Isolated browser profile and safe session-storage errors.

Share stream analysis across aliases of the active input, refresh unavailable match cards, and add optional H.264/AAC MPEG-TS playback compatibility for iOS without changing quality. Shorter HLS segments remain experimental and disabled by default.
Startup stage timing, first-data freshness and bounded replay diagnostics; optional near-live HLS startup without reducing source quality.
Favourites and Czech-day views, native ordering, availability explanations, optional shared-source resolution limit and privacy-safe diagnostic export.
Stable match links across upcoming/live transitions and artwork changes; preserves published 0.2.0 links and refreshes cached metadata.
Now-watching item and shared-input diagnostics; bounded reconnects; multiple favourite teams; XMLTV from known start times; wide sports artwork.
Select highest-resolution HLS variant and report offered qualities; official Kometa artwork for favourite item and TV playlist.
Initial experimental native plugin; one shared provider input.
